title: Hold approvals to provide a State regulated education and care service
what: Provide a State regulated education and care service (one outside the National Law) only as an approved provider, for an approved service.

laws.title: Children (Education and Care Services) Supplementary Provisions Act 2011 (NSW)

sources.title: Children (Education and Care Services) Supplementary Provisions Act 2011 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not provide a State regulated education and care service unless: (a) the person is an approved provider in respect of that service, and (b) the service is an approved education and care service
